svg.text: Fig. T1 — 25 vertices, every one an integer point
pitch 256 cells per unit; the numbers 1 to 25 run along the path from the right tip
curve x = t − t³/3, y = t²; A to D are the four parameters where the curve itself hits the lattice
the sides are whole as well: 65, 73, 89, 113, 145 cells …
